SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) FROM main.player AS p) AS extra_player_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS batting_rows,
    COUNT(p.player_id) AS matched_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(b.g) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS nonnumeric_g,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(b.r) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS nonnumeric_r,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(b.h) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS nonnumeric_h,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN typeof(b.hr) NOT IN ('integer', 'real', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS nonnumeric_hr
FROM main.batting AS b
LEFT JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = b.player_id

arguments.sql:
WITH player_stint_highs AS (
    SELECT
        b.player_id,
        MAX(b.g) AS games_played,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.r, '')) AS runs,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.h, '')) AS hits,
        MAX(NULLIF(b.hr, '')) AS home_runs
    FROM main.batting AS b
    GROUP BY b.player_id
),
category_highs AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(games_played) AS games_played,
        MAX(runs) AS runs,
        MAX(hits) AS hits,
        MAX(home_runs) AS home_runs
    FROM player_stint_highs
),
leaders AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category_order, 'Games played' AS statistic, s.player_id, s.games_played AS score
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.games_played = c.games_played

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 2, 'Runs', s.player_id, s.runs
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.runs = c.runs

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 3, 'Hits', s.player_id, s.hits
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.hits = c.hits

    UNION ALL

    SELECT 4, 'Home runs', s.player_id, s.home_runs
    FROM player_stint_highs AS s
    JOIN category_highs AS c ON s.home_runs = c.home_runs
)
SELECT l.statistic, p.name_given, l.score
FROM leaders AS l
JOIN main.player AS p ON p.player_id = l.player_id
ORDER BY l.category_order, p.name_given, l.player_id
LIMIT -1
